title: Image-to-3D Smith
idiom: graphite and charcoal academic atelier sketch
hero_prompt: A wide graphite and charcoal academic sketch of a sculptor's hand and chisel caught mid-strike against a stone block whose near face is still a flat framed photograph, the picture-plane fracturing into carved volume where the chisel bites. The sculptor is a man, rendered loosely in academy-drawing shading, evoked rather than portrayed as a specific person. Dust and stone chips scatter from the strike point. Hand-made graphite and charcoal academic atelier sketch, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a chisel striking a cube — thick black wedge and block shapes with a single spark burst — rendered as a stark charcoal silhouette with no fine linework, reading clearly as a small mark.
